osm_report.threat_description:
Obfuscated loader. Payload in tailwind.config.ts.
The decoded blob rewrites the Node module loader and unpacks a further hidden stage: a working multi-stage loader, not data.
The eval(atob(...)) loader hidden in a project file is Contagious Interview (DPRK-attributed) tradecraft.
Attribution: the tradecraft is consistent with North Korea, but a single signal is a lead rather than an attribution, so we do not attribute it on this evidence alone. Signals: Delivery vector matches Contagious-Interview tradecraft: obfuscated-eval-atob-loader.
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
osm_report.payload_description:
Malicious payload found in: tailwind.config.ts
- tailwind.config.ts:121: decodes a hidden blob and executes it at load time (obfuscated loader)
- tailwind.config.ts:121: hides code in an encoded blob that is decoded and run
